## Fix: ledger now actually created on open

The factory receives `worktree='/' ` (root) alongside the real directory, and `worktree || directory` picked the root — every sync silently no-opped through the root guard. Event payloads also carry the directory at `properties.info.directory`, not the top level.

Verified end-to-end with a headless `opencode run`: the ledger is created on open now.

## Fix: ledger sync uses the event payload directory

The plugin factory doesn't reliably receive the project directory in opencode 1.18.27's v1 loader, so the boot sync fell back to the binary cwd and silently no-opped. The sync now prefers the `session.created`/idle event's `directory`, and skips entirely when no directory context exists yet.

## Fix: ledger created on project open

The knowledge ledger only synced on `session.created` / `session.idle` — so opening OpenCode in a project and closing it without starting a conversation produced no `LEARNING_PATH.md`. The plugin now fires a guarded sync at boot, so the ledger appears as soon as OpenCode opens in a project (the freshness guard keeps repeat launches ~1ms).

## Fix: startup no longer blocks on ledger sync

- **Fire-and-forget sync**: the event hook no longer awaits the ledger update, so opencode opens instantly even on projects with large session history
- **Freshness guard**: a 5-minute window skips redundant rewrites; manual `npx opencode-craft sync` forces an immediate update
- **Faster sync**: single text-filtered JOIN query instead of one sqlite3 spawn per session, async exec, and a generous buffer (the 1MB default was silently degrading to the Python fallback on large projects)

If opencode appears stuck on an older version: `rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/packages/opencode-craft@latest`
